title: Grateful Dead Live at Freeborn Hall, University of California on 1971-01-21
lineage: Reel (Akai GX636) -> Apogee Mini-Me (24bit/96k) -> Apogee Mini-DAC -> Wavelab v5 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Crusty audience tape that still delivers a monster Other One and fiery China Cat Sunflower, highlighted by a seamless Smokestack Lightning → Truckin' segue.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its high‑energy second set – a 25‑minute Other One, a ripping China Cat Sunflower, and an excellent transition from Smokestack Lightning into Truckin'.  The audience recording is noted as “crusty” and lacking organ presence, but the playing shines through, especially Garcia’s space‑guitar interplay with Weir.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers laud the musical performance (many 5‑star comments) while repeatedly noting poor or mediocre sound quality, resulting in an overall strong show rating tempered by technical shortcomings.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crusty, low‑fidelity audience tape with muted organ and occasional muffled sections; overall not clear but listenable for the performance.

poor_songs: Other One (disorganized according to one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth segues, especially Smokestack Lightning into Truckin' and the transition from Cryptical Reprise into Cosmic Charlie; overall set praised for its tight flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s space‑guitar interplay during The Other One is highlighted as remarkable, with tight sparring against Weir.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm and vocal contributions are noted in the guitar “sparring” sections of The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Listeners note a lack of organ in the mix (Pigpen’s organ barely audible), reflecting limited keyboard presence on this tape.
